    <style>
        :root {
            --ds-primary-900: #0d1117;
            --ds-primary-800: #161b22;
            --ds-primary-700: #21262d;
            --ds-primary-600: #30363d;
            --ds-primary-500: #484f58;
            --ds-primary-400: #6e7681;
            --ds-primary-300: #8b949e;
            --ds-primary-200: #c9d1d9;
            --ds-primary-100: #f0f6fc;

            --ds-accent-900: #8b0000;
            --ds-accent-800: #a91b1b;
            --ds-accent-700: #c53030;
            --ds-accent-600: #e53e3e;
            --ds-accent-500: #f56565;
            --ds-accent-400: #fc8181;
            --ds-accent-300: #feb2b2;
            --ds-accent-200: #fed7d7;
            --ds-accent-100: #fff5f5;

            --ds-success-600: #16a34a;
            --ds-success-500: #22c55e;
            --ds-warning-600: #d97706;
            --ds-warning-500: #f59e0b;
            --ds-error-600: #dc2626;
            --ds-error-500: #ef4444;

            --ds-gradient-primary: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--ds-primary-800) 0%, var(--ds-primary-700) 100%);
            --ds-gradient-accent: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--ds-accent-700) 0%, var(--ds-accent-600) 100%);
            --ds-gradient-surface: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--ds-primary-700) 0%, var(--ds-primary-600) 100%);

            --ds-shadow-sm: 0 1px 2px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3);
            --ds-shadow-md: 0 4px 6px -1px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4), 0 2px 4px -1px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3);
            --ds-shadow-lg: 0 10px 15px -3px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5), 0 4px 6px -2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4);
            --ds-shadow-xl: 0 20px 25px -5px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6), 0 10px 10px -5px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4);

            --ds-radius-sm: 4px;
            --ds-radius-md: 8px;
            --ds-radius-lg: 12px;
            --ds-radius-xl: 16px;

            --ds-space-xs: 0.25rem;
            --ds-space-sm: 0.5rem;
            --ds-space-md: 1rem;
            --ds-space-lg: 1.5rem;
            --ds-space-xl: 2rem;
        }

        .btn-complete-read {
            background: var(--ds-gradient-accent);
            border: 1px solid var(--ds-accent-600);
            color: var(--ds-primary-100);
            transition: all 0.3s ease;
        }

        .btn-complete-read:hover {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--ds-accent-800) 0%, var(--ds-accent-700) 100%);
            border-color: var(--ds-accent-700);
            color: var(--ds-primary-100);
            transform: translateY(-2px);
            box-shadow: var(--ds-shadow-lg);
        }

        .content-reactions-section {
            margin-bottom: var(--ds-space-xl);
        }

        .content-reactions-section .card {
            border: none;
            border-radius: var(--ds-radius-xl);
            box-shadow: var(--ds-shadow-lg);
            background: var(--ds-gradient-surface);
            overflow: hidden;
            position: relative;
            border: 1px solid var(--ds-primary-500);
        }

        .content-reactions-section .card::before {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            right: 0;
            bottom: 0;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(245, 101, 101, 0.05) 0%, rgba(229, 62, 62, 0.02) 100%);
            pointer-events: none;
        }

        .content-reactions-section .card-header {
            background: transparent;
            border: none;
            padding: var(--ds-space-lg) var(--ds-space-lg) var(--ds-space-sm);
            position: relative;
            z-index: 1;
        }

        .content-reactions-section .card-header h5 {
            color: var(--ds-primary-200);
            font-weight: 600;
            text-shadow: 0 2px 4px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5);
            margin: 0;
            font-size: 1.1rem;
        }

        .content-reactions-section .card-body {
            background: rgba(33, 38, 45, 0.95);
            backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
            margin: 0 var(--ds-space-md) var(--ds-space-md);
            border-radius: var(--ds-radius-lg);
            padding: var(--ds-space-lg);
            position: relative;
            z-index: 1;
            border: 1px solid var(--ds-primary-500);
        }

        .reaction-buttons {
            display: flex;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
            gap: var(--ds-space-sm);
            justify-content: center;
        }

        transform: translateY(-3px) scale(1.05);
        box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(229, 62, 62, 0.4);
        }

        .reaction-stats-container {
            margin-top: var(--ds-space-lg);
            padding-top: var(--ds-space-lg);
            border-top: 2px solid var(--ds-primary-500);
        }

        .reaction-counts {
            display: flex;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
            gap: var(--ds-space-sm);
            margin-bottom: var(--ds-space-md);
            justify-content: center;
        }

        .reaction-count {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: var(--ds-space-xs);
            background: var(--ds-gradient-surface);
            padding: var(--ds-space-sm) var(--ds-space-md);
            border-radius: 20px;
            font-size: 14px;
            font-weight: 500;
            box-shadow: var(--ds-shadow-sm);
            transition: transform 0.3s ease;
            border: 1px solid var(--ds-primary-500);
            color: var(--ds-primary-200);
        }

        .reaction-count:hover {
            transform: translateY(-2px);
            box-shadow: var(--ds-shadow-md);
        }

        .reaction-count i {
            font-size: 16px;
            color: var(--ds-accent-500);
            filter: drop-shadow(0 1px 2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3));
        }

        .total-reactions {
            font-weight: 600;
            color: var(--ds-primary-200);
            font-size: 15px;
            text-align: center;
            padding: var(--ds-space-md);
            background: var(--ds-gradient-surface);
            border-radius: var(--ds-radius-md);
            border: 1px solid var(--ds-primary-500);
        }

        .no-reactions {
            color: var(--ds-primary-400);
            font-style: italic;
            text-align: center;
            padding: var(--ds-space-xl) var(--ds-space-lg);
            background: var(--ds-gradient-surface);
            border-radius: var(--ds-radius-lg);
            border: 2px dashed var(--ds-primary-500);
            font-size: 15px;
        }

        @media (max-width: 768px) {
            .content-reactions-section .card-body {
                margin: 0 var(--ds-space-sm) var(--ds-space-sm);
                padding: var(--ds-space-md);
            }

            .reaction-buttons {
                gap: var(--ds-space-xs);
            }

            .reaction-btn {
                font-size: 12px;
                padding: var(--ds-space-sm) var(--ds-space-md);
            }

            .reaction-btn .reaction-name {
                display: none;
            }

            .reaction-counts {
                gap: var(--ds-space-xs);
            }

            .reaction-count {
                padding: var(--ds-space-xs) var(--ds-space-sm);
                font-size: 12px;
            }
        }

        @media (max-width: 480px) {
            .content-reactions-section .card-header {
                padding: var(--ds-space-md) var(--ds-space-md) var(--ds-space-sm);
            }

            .content-reactions-section .card-header h5 {
                font-size: 1rem;
            }
        }

        .enhanced-chapters-section {}

        .chapter-controls {
            background: var(--ds-gradient-surface);
            padding: var(--ds-space-lg);
            border-radius: var(--ds-radius-lg);
            border: 1px solid var(--ds-primary-500);
            color: var(--ds-primary-200);
            box-shadow: var(--ds-shadow-md);
        }

        .chapter-controls h5 {
            color: var(--ds-primary-100);
            text-shadow: 0 2px 4px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5);
            margin-bottom: var(--ds-space-sm);
        }

        .chapter-controls .form-select {
            background: var(--ds-primary-700);
            border: 1px solid var(--ds-primary-500);
            color: var(--ds-primary-200);
            backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
            border-radius: var(--ds-radius-md);
        }

        .chapter-controls .form-select:focus {
            background: var(--ds-primary-600);
            border-color: var(--ds-accent-600);
            box-shadow: 0 0 0 0.2rem rgba(229, 62, 62, 0.25);
            color: var(--ds-primary-100);
        }

        .chapter-controls .form-select option {
            background: var(--ds-primary-700);
            color: var(--ds-primary-200);
        }

        .chapter-controls .btn-outline-secondary {
            border-color: var(--ds-primary-500);
            color: var(--ds-primary-200);
            background: var(--ds-primary-700);
            transition: all 0.3s ease;
        }

        .chapter-controls .btn-outline-secondary:hover {
            background: var(--ds-accent-700);
            border-color: var(--ds-accent-600);
            color: var(--ds-primary-100);
            transform: translateY(-2px);
            box-shadow: var(--ds-shadow-md);
        }

        .sorting-controls {
            background: var(--ds-primary-700);
            padding: var(--ds-space-sm);
            border-radius: var(--ds-radius-md);
            border: 1px solid var(--ds-primary-500);
        }

        .sorting-controls .form-label {
            color: var(--ds-primary-300);
            font-size: 0.875rem;
            font-weight: 500;
            white-space: nowrap;
        }

        .sort-indicator {
            background: var(--ds-accent-700);
            color: var(--ds-primary-100);
            padding: var(--ds-space-xs);
            border-radius: var(--ds-radius-sm);
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            min-width: 24px;
            height: 24px;
            transition: all 0.3s ease;
        }

        .sort-indicator i {
            font-size: 0.75rem;
        }

        .view-controls {
            background: var(--ds-primary-700);
            padding: var(--ds-space-xs);
            border-radius: var(--ds-radius-md);
            border: 1px solid var(--ds-primary-500);
        }

        .enhanced-chapters-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(280px, 1fr));
            gap: var(--ds-space-lg);
            margin-bottom: var(--ds-space-xl);
            margin-top: var(--ds-space-lg);
        }

        .chapter-card {
            background: var(--ds-gradient-surface);
            border-radius: var(--ds-radius-lg);
            overflow: hidden;
            box-shadow: var(--ds-shadow-md);
            transition: all 0.3s ease;
            border: 1px solid var(--ds-primary-500);
            position: relative;
        }

        .chapter-card::before {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            right: 0;
            bottom: 0;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(229, 62, 62, 0.02) 0%, rgba(197, 48, 48, 0.01) 100%);
            opacity: 0;
            transition: opacity 0.3s ease;
            pointer-events: none;
        }

        .chapter-card:hover {
            transform: translateY(-4px);
            box-shadow: var(--ds-shadow-lg);
            border-color: var(--ds-accent-600);
        }

        .chapter-card:hover::before {
            opacity: 1;
        }

        .chapter-link {
            text-decoration: none;
            color: inherit;
            display: block;
        }

        .chapter-link:hover {
            text-decoration: none;
            color: inherit;
        }

        .chapter-image-container {
            position: relative;
            height: 200px;
            overflow: hidden;
            background: var(--ds-gradient-accent);
        }

        .chapter-image {
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;
            object-fit: cover;
            transition: transform 0.3s ease;
        }

        .chapter-card:hover .chapter-image {
            transform: scale(1.05);
        }

        .chapter-placeholder {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            height: 100%;
            color: var(--ds-primary-100);
            font-size: 1.2rem;
            font-weight: 600;
            text-shadow: 0 2px 4px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5);
        }

        .chapter-placeholder i {
            font-size: 2.5rem;
            margin-bottom: var(--ds-space-sm);
            opacity: 0.9;
            filter: drop-shadow(0 2px 4px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5));
        }

        .chapter-status {
            position: absolute;
            top: var(--ds-space-sm);
            left: var(--ds-space-sm);
            display: flex;
            gap: var(--ds-space-xs);
        }

        .status-badge {
            background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.8);
            color: var(--ds-primary-100);
            padding: var(--ds-space-xs) var(--ds-space-sm);
            border-radius: var(--ds-radius-sm);
            font-size: 0.75rem;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: var(--ds-space-xs);
            backdrop-filter: blur(5px);
            font-weight: 500;
            border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
        }

        .status-badge.read {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--ds-success-600) 0%, var(--ds-success-500) 100%);
            box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(22, 163, 74, 0.3);
        }

        .status-badge.unread {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--ds-primary-500) 0%, var(--ds-primary-400) 100%);
            box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(72, 79, 88, 0.3);
        }

        .status-badge.locked {
            background: var(--ds-gradient-accent);
            box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(229, 62, 62, 0.3);
        }

        .status-badge.unlocked {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--ds-warning-600) 0%, var(--ds-warning-500) 100%);
            box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(217, 119, 6, 0.3);
        }

        .chapter-views {
            position: absolute;
            bottom: var(--ds-space-sm);
            right: var(--ds-space-sm);
            background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.8);
            color: var(--ds-primary-100);
            padding: var(--ds-space-xs) var(--ds-space-sm);
            border-radius: var(--ds-radius-lg);
            font-size: 0.75rem;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: var(--ds-space-xs);
            backdrop-filter: blur(5px);
            box-shadow: var(--ds-shadow-sm);
            font-weight: 500;
            border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
        }

        .chapter-views i {
            color: var(--ds-accent-400);
        }

        .chapter-info {
            padding: var(--ds-space-lg);
            background: var(--ds-primary-700);
            border-top: 1px solid var(--ds-primary-500);
        }

        .chapter-number {
            font-weight: 700;
            font-size: 1.1rem;
            color: var(--ds-primary-100);
            margin-bottom: var(--ds-space-xs);
            text-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3);
        }

        .chapter-title {
            font-size: 0.9rem;
            color: var(--ds-primary-300);
            margin-bottom: var(--ds-space-sm);
            line-height: 1.4;
            display: -webkit-box;
            -webkit-line-clamp: 2;
            -webkit-box-orient: vertical;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .chapter-date {
            font-size: 0.8rem;
            color: var(--ds-accent-400);
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: var(--ds-space-xs);
            font-weight: 500;
        }

        .chapter-date i {
            color: var(--ds-accent-500);
        }

        .enhanced-chapters-grid.list-view {
            grid-template-columns: 1fr;
            gap: var(--ds-space-md);
        }

        .enhanced-chapters-grid.list-view .chapter-card {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: row;
            height: 120px;
            min-height: 120px;
        }

        .enhanced-chapters-grid.list-view .chapter-image-container {
            width: 200px;
            height: 120px;
            flex-shrink: 0;
            min-width: 200px;
        }

        .enhanced-chapters-grid.list-view .chapter-info {
            flex: 1;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            justify-content: center;
            border-top: none;
            border-left: 1px solid var(--ds-primary-500);
            padding: var(--ds-space-md);
            min-width: 0;
            position: absolute;
            left: 0;
            width: 200px;
            height: 100%;
        }

        .enhanced-chapters-grid.list-view .chapter-number {
            font-size: 1rem;
            font-weight: 700;
            color: var(--ds-primary-100);
            margin-bottom: var(--ds-space-xs);
            display: block !important;
            visibility: visible !important;
        }

        .enhanced-chapters-grid.list-view .chapter-title {
            font-size: 0.875rem;
            color: var(--ds-primary-300);
            margin-bottom: var(--ds-space-xs);
            display: block !important;
            visibility: visible !important;
            line-height: 1.3;
            -webkit-line-clamp: 2;
        }

        .enhanced-chapters-grid.list-view .chapter-date {
            font-size: 0.75rem;
            color: var(--ds-accent-400);
            display: flex !important;
            visibility: visible !important;
            align-items: center;
            gap: var(--ds-space-xs);
        }

        .enhanced-chapters-grid.list-view .chapter-status {
            position: absolute;
            top: var(--ds-space-xs);
            left: var(--ds-space-xs);
            z-index: 2;
        }

        .enhanced-chapters-grid.list-view .chapter-views {
            position: absolute;
            bottom: var(--ds-space-xs);
            right: var(--ds-space-xs);
            z-index: 2;
        }

        @media (max-width: 768px) {
            .enhanced-chapters-grid {
                grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(250px, 1fr));
                gap: var(--ds-space-md);
            }

            .chapter-controls .row {
                flex-direction: column;
                gap: var(--ds-space-md);
            }

            .chapter-controls .col-md-6:last-child {
                text-align: left;
            }

            .chapter-controls .d-flex {
                flex-direction: column;
                align-items: flex-start !important;
                gap: var(--ds-space-sm);
            }

            .sorting-controls {
                width: 100%;
                justify-content: space-between;
            }

            .view-controls {
                align-self: flex-end;
            }

            .enhanced-chapters-grid.list-view .chapter-card {
                flex-direction: column;
                height: auto;
            }

            .enhanced-chapters-grid.list-view .chapter-image-container {
                width: 100%;
                height: 150px;
            }

            .enhanced-chapters-grid.list-view .chapter-info {
                border-left: none;
                border-top: 1px solid var(--ds-primary-500);

// دالة لتحديد الإشعار كمقروء
function markNotificationAsRead(notificationId) {
    fetch(`/comment-notifications/${notificationId}/mark-as-read`, {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: {
            'Content-Type': 'application/json',
            'X-CSRF-TOKEN': document.querySelector('meta[name="csrf-token"]').getAttribute('content')
        }
    })
    .then(response => response.json())
    .then(data => {
        if (data.success) {
            // تحديث عداد الإشعارات
            const notificationCount = document.querySelector('.notification-count');
            if (notificationCount && data.unread_count !== undefined) {
                if (data.unread_count > 0) {
                    notificationCount.textContent = data.unread_count > 99 ? '99+' : data.unread_count;
                } else {
                    notificationCount.style.display = 'none';
                }
            }

            // إزالة علامة "جديد" من الإشعار
            const notificationItem = document.querySelector(`[data-notification-id="${notificationId}"]`);
            if (notificationItem) {
                const newBadge = notificationItem.querySelector('.bg-\\[\\#e4334d\\]');
                if (newBadge && newBadge.textContent.includes('جديد')) {
                    newBadge.remove();
                }
            }
        }
    })
    .catch(error => {
        console.error('خطأ في تحديد الإشعار كمقروء:', error);
    });
}

        <script>
            // Live Search — debounced + abortable + loading state.
            // Improvements over the previous version:
            //  - 250 ms debounce so typing doesn't fire a request per keystroke
            //  - AbortController cancels in-flight requests when the user keeps typing
            //  - 2-character minimum (was 3) — shorter Arabic words exist
            //  - shows a loading spinner while waiting
            //  - hides results on Escape
            //  - hides results when the input is cleared
            function initLiveSearch(searchInput, resultsContainer) {
                if (!searchInput || !resultsContainer) return;

                const SEARCH_URL = "https://olympustaff.com/ajax/search";
                const MIN_LEN = 2;
                const DEBOUNCE_MS = 250;
                let debounceTimer = null;
                let inflight = null;

                const showResults = () => {
                    resultsContainer.classList.remove('hidden');
                    resultsContainer.classList.add('action');
                };
                const hideResults = () => {
                    resultsContainer.classList.add('hidden');
                    resultsContainer.classList.remove('action');
                };
                const showLoading = () => {
                    resultsContainer.innerHTML =
                        '<div class="p-6 text-center"><i class="fa fa-circle-notch fa-spin text-[#e4334d] text-2xl"></i></div>';
                    showResults();
                };

                const runSearch = (term) => {
                    if (inflight) {
                        inflight.abort();
                    }
                    inflight = new AbortController();
                    showLoading();
                    fetch(SEARCH_URL + '?keyword=' + encodeURIComponent(term), {
                        signal: inflight.signal,
                        headers: { 'X-Requested-With': 'XMLHttpRequest' },
                        credentials: 'same-origin',
                    })
                        .then((r) => r.ok ? r.text() : Promise.reject(r.status))
                        .then((html) => {
                            resultsContainer.innerHTML = html;
                            showResults();
                        })
                        .catch((err) => {
                            if (err && err.name === 'AbortError') return;
                            resultsContainer.innerHTML =
                                '<div class="p-6 text-center text-[#e4334d] text-sm">حدث خطأ، حاول مرة أخرى</div>';
                            showResults();
                        });
                };

                searchInput.addEventListener('input', (event) => {
                    const term = event.target.value.trim();
                    clearTimeout(debounceTimer);

                    if (term.length < MIN_LEN) {
                        if (inflight) inflight.abort();
                        hideResults();
                        return;
                    }

                    debounceTimer = setTimeout(() => runSearch(term), DEBOUNCE_MS);
                });

                searchInput.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
                    if (e.key === 'Escape') hideResults();
                });

                document.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
                    if (!searchInput.contains(e.target) && !resultsContainer.contains(e.target)) {
                        hideResults();
                    }
                });
            }

            initLiveSearch(document.getElementById('search'),               document.getElementById('results'));
            initLiveSearch(document.getElementById('mobile-search-input'),  document.getElementById('mobile-results'));
        </script>

            const lazyImages = document.querySelectorAll('.lazy-load');
            const imageObserver = new IntersectionObserver((entries, observer) => {
                entries.forEach(entry => {
                    if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                        const img = entry.target;
                        img.classList.add('loaded');
                        observer.unobserve(img);
                    }
                });
            });

            lazyImages.forEach(img => {
                imageObserver.observe(img);
            });

            function updateSortIndicator(sortType) {
                if (!sortIndicator) return;

                const indicators = {
                    'chapter_asc': {
                        icon: 'fas fa-sort-numeric-up',

                    'chapter_desc': {
                        icon: 'fas fa-sort-numeric-down',

                const indicator = indicators[sortType];
                if (indicator) {
                    sortIndicator.innerHTML = `<i class="${indicator.icon}" title="${indicator.title}"></i>`;
                }
            }

            function applySorting(sortType) {
                const sortedCards = [...chapterCards].sort((a, b) => {
                    switch (sortType) {
                        case 'chapter_asc':
                            return parseInt(a.dataset.number) - parseInt(b.dataset.number);
                        case 'chapter_desc':
                            return parseInt(b.dataset.number) - parseInt(a.dataset.number);

                applySorting(savedSortType);

            }

            if (toggleView) {
                let isListView = savedViewType === 'list';

                toggleView.addEventListener('click', function() {
                    isListView = !isListView;

                    if (isListView) {

                        localStorage.setItem('chapterViewType', 'list');

                    }
                });

                        reactionStatsContainer.innerHTML = html;

                        document.querySelectorAll('.reaction-btn').forEach(button => {
                            button.addEventListener('click', debounce(function() {
                                const typeId = button.getAttribute('data-type-id');
                                addReaction(typeId, button);
                            }, 300));
                        });
                    })
                    .catch(error => {
                        console.error('Error loading reaction stats:', error);
                        hideLoadingState();
                        showErrorState('Failed to load reactions. Please try again.');
                    });
            }

            function addReaction(typeId, buttonElement) {
                if (buttonElement) {
                    buttonElement.disabled = true;
                    buttonElement.classList.add('loading');
                }

                fetch('/content-reactions', {
                        method: 'POST',
                        headers: {
                            'Content-Type': 'application/json',
                            'X-CSRF-TOKEN': document.querySelector('meta[name="csrf-token"]').getAttribute(
                                'content')
                        },
                        body: JSON.stringify({
                            reaction_type_id: typeId,
                            manga_id: mangaId
                        })
                    })
                    .then(response => {
                        if (!response.ok) {
                            if (response.status === 401) {
                                alert('يرجى تسجيل الدخول للتفاعل مع المانجا');
                                return;
                            }
                            throw new Error(`HTTP error! status: ${response.status}`);
                        }
                        return response.json();
                    })
                    .then(data => {
                        if (data && data.error) {
                            throw new Error(data.message || 'Failed to process reaction');
                        }

                        if (buttonElement) {
                            buttonElement.classList.add('success-pulse');
                            setTimeout(() => {
                                buttonElement.classList.remove('success-pulse');
                            }, 600);
                        }

                        loadReactionStats();
                    })
                    .catch(error => {
                        console.error('Error adding reaction:', error);
                        showErrorState('Failed to process reaction. Please try again.');
                    })
                    .finally(() => {
                        if (buttonElement) {
                            buttonElement.disabled = false;
                            buttonElement.classList.remove('loading');
                        }
                    });
            }

            function debounce(func, wait) {
                let timeout;
                return function executedFunction(...args) {
                    const later = () => {
                        clearTimeout(timeout);
                        func(...args);
                    };
                    clearTimeout(timeout);
                    timeout = setTimeout(later, wait);
                };
            }

            function showLoadingState() {
                if (reactionStatsContainer) {
                    reactionStatsContainer.innerHTML = `
                        <div class="reactions-loading">
                            <div class="loading-spinner"></div>
                            <span>Loading reactions...</span>
                        </div>
                    `;
                }
            }

            function hideLoadingState() {
                const loadingElement = document.querySelector('.reactions-loading');
                if (loadingElement) {
                    loadingElement.remove();
                }
            }

            function showErrorState(message) {
                if (reactionStatsContainer) {
                    reactionStatsContainer.innerHTML = `
                        <div class="reactions-error">
                            <span class="error-icon">⚠️</span>
                            <span class="error-message">${message}</span>
                            <button class="retry-btn" onclick="window.loadReactionTypes()">Retry</button>
                        </div>
                    `;
                }
            }

            if (reactionTypesContainer && reactionStatsContainer) {
                window.loadReactionTypes();
                loadReactionStats();
            }
        });
